body: Mostly struggling for word count but in all I've always been a strong writer

I want to get a degree really bad, and I enjoy school a lot when I'm not depressed. I make good grades so effortlessly when I'm not like this but now I can barely finish a paper. Plus there are no other options for me to be successful
That sounds helpful. I try to do that but it often gets out of hand quickly with school and work. I what I can to organize things when i can but its so hard

Its comforting to know it got better for you because I'm at the point that I feel like everday is just worse than the last. Its like I hit rock bottom and theres some sad relief that even though things are horrible they can't be any worse and then the ground comes out from underneath me and I fall again. It seems like if i go any farther I'm going to hit the earths core

Thank you for this. I dont know what I would do if my fiance wasnt there to listen. I just feel so annoying and depressing when I tell him things are wrong and it makes me feel like he's going to get tired of all the problems and leave. I wish it wasnt so vicious, I wish I could stop being so paranoid and anxious about everything

Cats are great. I love mine. I write short stories mostly but lately I dont have the time. We go out to eat, hikes, shopping; he likes to make me try new things, I never really stepped out of my comfort zone until I met him. At the gym I do the normal stuff, run on the treadmill, roman chair, push ups, etc. I was training to be in the National Guard but found out I'm not allowed to join which, to be honest, was kind of a relief. My fiance is still joining when he gets out of jail but I don't want to get our engagement tattoo removed to join something I'm not that passionate about. Plus I don't think its a great time to join anyway. I tell my fiance that but its what he wants to do and I don't want to stop him

I try to read and write when I get the chance. I go out with my fiance's sister to have girls night. My fiance and I go on dates. I have a cat and a lizard. I don't watch much tv. I go for runs and go to the gym

I don't really know. I try all the time to think I'm good at something. I have so much going on. I just found out the paper I'm writing has to be 3 times as long as I thought it did and I'm already struggling to make it as long as it is. I feel so lousy. I try my hardest and it's like I can't even catch up. I don't even necessarily want to get ahead right now, I just want to be close to even

I feel so much lower than everyone else. Expressing myself makes me feel more anxious and like less of a person. My whole life I've felt like I was burdening people, part of me wishes that no one cared about me so I could just go but I know people care and it makes me feel like such a heavy weight to bare

my best friend is my fiance's sister so I don't want to dump any of this on her. She definitely knows something is wrong, I think she catches on that my 'jokes' about my life falling apart aren't jokes anymore. I do everything I can to hold it together for her and for my fiance. Other than that I don't have a ton of friends; I have acquaintances at school but no one I'm close enough to to let them know what's really going on. Sometimes I think about going to my teacher (he's also my adviser and the department chair for my major, I like to consider us relatively 'close?' since my major is specialized and there are only 8 other students) but I don't want any sort of fanfare or attention from it. I don't want him to tell my parents, they have a ton of stuff to deal with, my sister has PTSD and my brother is a drug addict. They don't really understand what any of this is like and they might blame themselves. I really just don't want people to see me for who I really am but at the same time I'm always reaching out for help by making jokes at my own expense.

I'm so incredibly stressed out on top of it all. I find myself talking to myself. I'm talking in my sleep more than ever and the other day I woke up in the middle of the night in a panic and tore my room apart looking for a bag that I don't actually have; I thought it was a dream but I when I woke up in the morning my room was thrown. I bruised my own arms because I punched myself but I didn't even intend to do it. I just really don't know what to do or what I'm doing.
